v1.3_rejected_v4_retrain.verdict: REJECTED - shipped model remains the v1.1 model. The v4 retrain (identical 16 features, hyperparameters, seed and split; v4 table = v3 rows reproduced 1:1 + 14,359 hardcontent label rows) showed no improvement: deltas within noise, slightly negative on every non-hc slice. The 410 hardcontent segments (0.8% of rows) could not move the model.
v1.3_rejected_v4_retrain.note: Head-to-head on the identical held-out test split (180,642 rows; md5(source_key)%100). new_v4 = rejected retrain, old_prod = shipped model.
v1.3_rejected_v4_retrain.known_gap: both models land ~5 VMAF below target on hardcontent (vmaf_bias -5.1) - to be addressed by a dedicated hardcontent measurement dataset (in progress).

v1.6_preset_offsets.note: predict.py --preset + preset_offsets.json: measured CRF offsets for non-baseline encoder presets, derived from preset_delta v1.0 (Track 2). delta = CRF(preset) - CRF(baseline) at equal VMAF via inverse interpolation of per-clip CRF ladders; median over VMAF targets 75-95 and clips. 44 cells (codec x preset x resolution). Model unchanged.
v1.6_preset_offsets.delta_stability: delta roughly constant across VMAF targets 75-95 (+/-0.5 within a cell) -> single median per cell; per-target modeling not warranted
v1.6_preset_offsets.direction_sanity: slower presets -> positive delta (x264 slow +3.2..+3.6, x265 slow +3.1..+3.6, av1 p6 +3.4..+5.4); av1 p12 vs p10 baseline negative (-2.1..-3.4; p12 is faster than p10); monotone within codec preset order
